```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
```

#Read in all the files in the raw data folder 
```{r}
files <- list.files(path = "2021 Raw Data", full.names = TRUE)

# 3. Read and combine all CSVs
all_data <- files %>%
    lapply(function(file) {
    df <- read_excel(file, col_types = "text", range = cell_limits(c(6, 1), c(NA, 10)))
    return(df)
  }) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% 
  rename(Collection_Date = `Collection Date`, 
         Run_Date = `Run Date`, 
         Grid_Square = `Grid Square`, 
         Sample_ID = `Sample ID`, 
         CH4_Area = `CH4 Peak Area`, 
         CO2_Area = `CO2 Peak Area`, 
         CH4_ppm = `CH4 (ppm)`, 
         CO2_ppm = `CO2 (ppm)`) %>% 
  mutate(Collection_Date = as.Date(as.numeric(Collection_Date), origin = "1899-12-30")) %>% 
  mutate(Run_Date = as.Date(as.numeric(Run_Date), origin = "1899-12-30")) 

```


##Calculate umol/L from ppm

```{r}
##Calculate mean of CO2 data for each Plot
##Make columns 18 to 21 numeric
all_data1 <- all_data %>%
  mutate(across(7:10, ~as.numeric(as.character(.)))) %>% 
  mutate(CH4_ppm = ifelse(CH4_ppm < 0, 0, CH4_ppm))

C_mean_CO2 = mean(subset(all_data1, Plot == "Control")$CO2_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)
F_mean_CO2 = mean(subset(all_data1, Plot == "Freshwater")$CO2_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)
S_mean_CO2 = mean(subset(all_data1, Plot == "Seawater")$CO2_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)

##Flag data that is more than 100x the mean 
all_data1 <- all_data1 %>% 
  mutate(qaqc_flag = NA) %>% 
  mutate(qaqc_flag = case_when(
    Plot == "Control" & CO2_ppm >= 10*C_mean_CO2 ~ "CO2 more than ten times higher than the plot mean, not real value",
    Plot == "Freshwater" & CO2_ppm >= 10*F_mean_CO2 ~ "CO2 more than ten times higher than the plot mean, not real value",
    Plot == "Seawater" & CO2_ppm >= 10*S_mean_CO2 ~ "CO2 more than ten times higher than the plot mean, not real value"
  ))

##Calculate mean of CH4 data for each Site
C_mean_CH4 = mean(subset(all_data1, Plot == "Control")$CH4_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)
F_mean_CH4 = mean(subset(all_data1, Plot == "Freshwater")$CH4_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)
S_mean_CH4 = mean(subset(all_data1, Plot == "Seawater")$CH4_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)

##Flag data that is more than 100x the mean 
all_data1 <- all_data1 %>% 
  mutate(qaqc_flag = case_when(
    Plot == "Control" & CH4_ppm >= 10*C_mean_CH4 ~ paste0(qaqc_flag, " CH4 more than ten times higher than the plot mean, not real value"),
    Plot == "Freshwater" & CH4_ppm >= 10*F_mean_CH4 ~ paste0(qaqc_flag, " CH4 more than ten times higher than the plot mean,, not real value"),
    Plot == "Seawater" & CH4_ppm >= 10*S_mean_CH4 ~ paste0(qaqc_flag, " CH4 more than ten times higher than the plot mean,, not real value")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(qaqc_flag = gsub("NA ", "", qaqc_flag))

```


## Write the 2021 file out to the folder 
```{r, echo=FALSE}

write.csv(all_data1, "COMPASS_TEMPEST_SGAS_2021.csv")

```
